// diagnostic

E0383

This source loop uses a retired comma between its binding and source.

What

This source loop uses a retired comma between its binding and source.

Why

A source loop uses `in` to mark the binding/source boundary; commas remain for later clauses such as a stride.

Fix

Replace the comma after the binding with `in`, for example `loop item in items { … }`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0383: tests/ui/loop_source_comma_retired.stderr.

Error [E0383]: this source loop uses a retired comma between its binding and source.
  --> tests/ui/loop_source_comma_retired.jet:2:11
    |
  2 |     loop x, xs { print(x) }
    |           ^
 Why: A source loop uses `in` to mark the binding/source boundary; commas remain for later clauses such as a stride.
 Fix: replace the comma after the binding with `in`, for example `loop item in items { … }`.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0383

Error [E0107]: nothing named `xs` exists here
  --> tests/ui/loop_source_comma_retired.jet:2:13
    |
  2 |     loop x, xs { print(x) }
    |             ^^
 Why: a name must be declared before it's used
 Fix: declare it first: `xs :: ...`
